faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Uttarakhand Jal Vidyut Nigam (UJVNL) for filling up senior director level positions in the power sector.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under UJVNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for various Director positions including Project, Operation, Finance, and Human Resource.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 16 October 2026, within 30 days of the notification release.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range offered for UJVNL Director posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary according to Pay Matrix Level-16 ranging from Rs. 182200 to Rs. 224100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 45 years and 60 years of age to be eligible for applying to the UJVNL Director positions.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Director (Project)?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Degree in Engineering, Chartered Accountancy, Cost Accountancy, Post Graduation, or an MBA along with relevant energy sector experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for UJVNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Principal Secretary, Energy Department, Secretariat Office, Room No. 201, Second Floor, Vishwakarma Bhawan, 4 Subhash Road, Dehradun.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a thorough screening of the received applications followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by clicking the direct link provided in the important links section of this article.
